content_fields.title: Verify that typical database and server activities, along with related metadata, are logged
content_fields.description: Verify that database and server activity is being logged with the required metadata.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming the logging settings are active, generating a representative event and observing it arrive in central storage with the expected fields.
content_fields.found: No logging configuration or destination exists to verify.
content_fields.missing: The database logging configuration and central log storage.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification depends on server configuration outside this repository.
content_fields.action: The database administration team should verify logging once it is configured.
